title: 中国人民银行副行长陈德霖：中国经济转型创新，科技驱动长期增长
speaker: Chen Derling

segments.en: China as a central driver for the global economy, China's mainland economy is also a supporting foundation for Hong Kong's development.
segments.zh: 中国作为全球经济核心引擎，内地经济也是香港发展的支撑基础。

segments.en: Two weeks ago, Premier Li Qian, speech at the summit, that the stability of China's development is depending on two factors, first, the stable environment, second, the new channels, technology innovation is the long-term strategy for China's development.
segments.zh: 两周前，李强总理在峰会上表示，中国发展稳定取决于两个因素：稳定环境和科技创新，这是长期战略。

segments.en: China has the huge market and the complete value chain and high-speed development of technology and the large pool of talents. China's company are investing a lot in R&D and helping the integration of research with industry.
segments.zh: 中国拥有巨大市场、完整价值链、高速发展的科技和庞大人才库。企业大力投入研发，促进产学研融合。

segments.en: Our growth model shifted from the production elements to innovation and from manufacturing to high-tech development and emerging technologies. This sustainable development of technology offers us resilience and long-term growth.
segments.zh: 增长模式从要素驱动转向创新驱动，从制造转向高科技和新兴技术。科技的可持续发展带来韧性和长期增长。

segments.en: Starting from this year, China will focus on more high-tech development through the master plan and the mid-term check and the end-term targets and China is trying to ensure the high-quality development.
segments.zh: 从今年起，中国将通过总体规划、中期检查和期末目标聚焦高科技发展，确保高质量增长。
